{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored trousers, straight leg, ankle length, deep charcoal (#36454F), wool-blend twill
Blouse, relaxed fit with a soft collar, hip length, ivory (#F2EBDD), matte crepe
Fine-gauge knit cardigan, slim fit, hip length, camel (#B98A5E), merino wool with a subtle texture
Trench coat, belted, knee length, warm stone (#BFB2A0), water-repellent cotton gabardine
Ankle boots, low block heel, rounded toe, dark chocolate (#4A3328), water-resistant smooth leather
Compact umbrella, dark navy (#1F2A44), waterproof fabric
Tote bag, structured, medium size, cognac (#A0522D), grained leather
Scarf, light, burgundy (#6D2434), soft wool-silk blend

This outfit suits a neat business meeting in a café: the trousers, blouse and textured cardigan give a polished, professional look without feeling stiff. The warm, earthy autumn palette feels approachable and confident, which helps when meeting a client. The trench, water-resistant boots and umbrella handle cool, rainy weather, while the layers can easily come off indoors. The structured tote keeps your documents tidy and completes the look."}
